header.description: Minimized repros for divergences found and fixed during the wave-4 transform integration plus the codex round-3 (r3-* ids) and round-4 (r4-* ids) findings. Each compiled differently (or errored differently) before its fix; the oracle is @stylexjs/babel-plugin 0.19.0 run live. Fixture dependency trees live in fixtures/*/nm and are materialized to node_modules by run.sh.
